home.title: Food delivery in Sharm El Sheikh
home.summary: Find restaurants and delivery areas in Sharm El Sheikh. Check how to order to your hotel, apartment or beach meeting point.

areas.title: Food delivery areas in Sharm El Sheikh
areas.summary: Sharm Eats lists 11 delivery zones. The restaurants that can serve you depend on your exact pin and the kitchen’s delivery radius.
areas.how: Which fee applies to my address?
areas.answer: Set the meeting point in the app before picking a kitchen. Check the fee for that order at checkout, especially near the edge of a zone.
areas.map: Is the nearest restaurant always available?
areas.mapAnswer: A restaurant’s location tells you where its kitchen is. Opening hours, delivery range and your pin determine whether you can order from it.

hotels.title: Food delivery to hotels in Sharm El Sheikh
hotels.summary: Set your hotel’s location in the app, then ask reception where outside couriers can hand over food. A resort’s entrance and guest lobby can be different meeting points.
hotels.where: Can a driver come to my room?
hotels.handoff: Room access depends on the property. Before you confirm, agree on the gate, lobby or another permitted meeting point and include it in your delivery notes.
hotels.address: What should I enter for the address?
hotels.pin: Enter the property name, place a pin at the agreed entrance and add the identifying landmark. Keep your contact number reachable so the driver can find you.
hotels.beach: Can I meet my rider at the beach?
hotels.beachAnswer: Choose a publicly accessible meeting point or the entrance your beach club approves. A pin on the water or on a private strip may lead the rider to the wrong side.

how.title: How to order food in Sharm El Sheikh
how.summary: Choose your address, check the available kitchen and menu, then review the delivery fee and total in Egyptian pounds before confirming.
how.guest: Can I order as a guest?
how.guestAnswer: You can order in the customer app as a guest. Enter a reachable phone number including its country code and accept the terms at checkout.
how.feesAnswer: The base fee varies by zone. Your kitchen, location and any applicable offer determine the amount shown before you place the order.
how.paymentAnswer: Pay the courier in Egyptian pounds on delivery. Check the total before you confirm and have the amount ready for handoff.
how.tracking: How do I follow my order?
how.trackingAnswer: Open your order in the app for its status and estimated arrival. Use the in-app chat or contact support if the handoff point changes.

order.title: Order food with Sharm Eats
order.summary: Open the Sharm Eats customer app to enter your delivery pin, see available kitchens and place your order.
order.step: For hotels, agree on the entrance with reception. For apartments, add the building and entrance.
order.end: Review available dishes, the delivery fee and total in EGP before you confirm.

restaurants.title: Restaurants in Sharm El Sheikh
restaurants.summary: Browse restaurant listings by neighborhood. Enter your exact address in the customer app to check which kitchens can deliver.

demo.title: Sharm Eats app preview
demo.summary: Try the customer, driver and restaurant screens with example orders. This interactive preview uses sample data.

area.pin: Where should I put the delivery pin?
area.feeNote: The app shows the final fee for your address and order.

naama.title: Food delivery in Naama Bay
naama.summary: Order to a hotel, apartment or agreed pickup point in Naama Bay. On the promenade, select a reachable entrance before choosing your restaurant.
naama.pin: Pin the entrance nearest the road. If you are on the promenade, add the name of a visible storefront or the hotel entrance.
naama.where: Check with reception before choosing a lobby. Staying at a rental? Add the building entrance, floor and a reachable contact number in the app.

nabq.title: Food delivery in Nabq Bay
nabq.summary: For a resort delivery in Nabq, use the gate approved by your hotel. Kitchens can serve different parts of the bay, so set the actual destination first.
nabq.pin: Use the full resort name and the agreed gate. A pin in the middle of a large resort can point the driver towards a different entrance.
nabq.where: Ask the front desk if the driver may enter or whether you should meet at security. Add the agreed gate to delivery notes.

hadaba.title: Food delivery in Hadaba, Sharm El Sheikh
hadaba.summary: For an apartment or villa in Hadaba, enter the building or compound entrance. Sharm Eats lists Hadaba and El-Hadaba Residential as separate zones.
hadaba.pin: Pin the street entrance and add the building name or number. Select the zone for your actual address, especially near El-Hadaba Residential.
hadaba.where: Give the entrance and floor in the app. In a gated compound, agree on an accessible meeting point and keep your phone available.
